description: Returns the shared Delx Wellness profile (~/.delx-wellness/profile.json). Read-only. Surfaces the user's preferred location, sensitivity flags (asthma, etc.), and units so wellness-air can choose tighter AQI thresholds.

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits location identifiers and device serials when present; structured/raw return full payload.

name: air_profile_get
title: Air profile get
